title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Housing Security Anti Eviction and Urban Land Equity Bill
objective: Track forced eviction prevention, 90-day notice compliance, and 30% urban land pooling quota.
affected_groups: Urban residents and informal settlement dwellers

indicators.name: Affordable Public Housing Land Allocation
indicators.definition: Percentage of pooled urban land reserved and developed for low-income housing.

oversight.composition: Urban planners, housing rights advocates, judges
oversight.powers: Statutory audit and stay order issuance

triggers.condition: Attempted demolition or eviction without 90-day written notice and judicial order.
triggers.interim_protection: Mandatory immediate stay order halting demolition
